snippet.title: Gentoo Rescue - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
For my puzzle metroidvania game:

A puzzler about sliding penguins and walruses. Pick up items to push, pull, bounce, swap, stop, steal, or explode. Uncover surprising twists hidden in a world of puzzles inside puzzles inside puzzles.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830480/Gentoo_Rescue/
Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2883360/Gentoo_Rescue_Demo/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Z6C37GCu5H
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/jagriff.bsky.social
